text: Fiji's Climate and Disaster Risk Financing and parametric insurance initiative aims to provide rapid financial relief to vulnerable groups affected by cyclones and extreme rainfall. Launched in 2021, it is the first parametric insurance product in the Pacific, designed to deliver quick payouts based on objective triggers like wind speed and rainfall intensity. The initiative is part of the Pacific Insurance and Climate Adaptation Programme (PICAP) and involves collaboration between public, private, and international organizations to enhance inclusion, digital delivery, and scalability.
